summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of NEURAL STRIKE. Backend: 5/5 pytest checks pass over WSS ingress (REST /api/healthz, /api/, WS hello+two-client join with distinct skins, full match flow (ready->match_start->deploy->state/snapshot->fire->hit->kill->score), room-full at 13th client). Frontend engine-free mode (?renderGame=false): 44/44 UI checks pass - main-menu-shell renders, all 7 nav testids present, PLAY panel with prefilled callsign 'Viper-10', mode-quick/create/join reveal their sub-controls, LOADOUT shows all 4 weapon cards (rifle, smg, g31, sniper), PROFILE shows stats grid + name input + reset btn, COMMUNITY shows Discord/X/Website/Updates, CREDITS mentions MIT/Workmelt/three.js. Branding correct: title 'NEURAL STRIKE — Tactical Shooter', wordmark 'NEURAL STRIKE', no 'WORKMELT' text in shell (only in credits attribution as expected). Invite deep-link ?room=abcd12 shows invite-banner with 'ABCD12' and prefills join-code-input.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider lifespan handler for FastAPI 0.100+ compatibility.

reaper_loop closes stale peers but iterates room.peers while awaiting leave() which mutates it - could raise RuntimeError under load; wrap in try/except (currently safe due to list() snapshot but leave() removes items concurrently is fine).
MAX_START_MS derivation from COUNTDOWN_MS*3 - if COUNTDOWN_MS env override set, MAX_START_MS won't reflect it unless also set explicitly. Minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (5 tests: REST healthz/root, WS two-client join, full match flow, room-full). Runs against WSS ingress in ~57s. Frontend must be tested with ?renderGame=false due to headless GPU limitation; the real 3D FPS canvas cannot be tested in this env. All data-testids for shell are working. Invite banner is present when ?room=<code> is in URL and auto-selects Join mode.
